problem: pack no longer reverses stream bodies, so the wire format differs from main and reference_impl and blocks are misdecoded across versions without any error.

unpack reverses each stream again on top of _ref.unpack, which already reverses, so decoding any block from reference_impl.pack or main's pack returns reversed streams; round-trip only passes because the two errors cancel.

Production module hard-imports reference_impl (a reference oracle) while still duplicating split/join/encode/decode/constants, adding an import-failure and sys.path-shadowing risk and making oracle comparisons circular.
Length check uses _ref.MAX_TABLE_LENGTH instead of the local constant, so the two can drift and an oversized stream would raise OverflowError from to_bytes instead of ValueError.
pack's ValueError messages dropped the observed stream count, length and maximum that main reported.
